title: ATCraftMC
description: A new creative CMP server aimed for advanced experience.
body:
# ATCraftMC ——「幻方公艺」

Welcome to **ATCraftMC**, a Minecraft server focused on **creative building and city construction**.
</br>欢迎来到ATCraftMC——一个充满激情与创造力的MC服务器集群！

Here you can freely design, build, and collaborate with other players to create impressive structures and cities.

我们有着从生存到创造，从原版到模组的多种玩法。无论探险，枪战，还是创造，设计，我们都有适合你的游戏内容。在这里，你不仅可以尽情释放你的建造激情，打造属于自己的梦幻世界，还能结识一群志同道合的朋友，共同探索游戏的无限可能性。我们持续添加新的游戏玩法，以及激动人心的活动，为玩家提供新鲜刺激的游戏体验。无论你是喜欢探险，还是热衷于创造，我们都有适合你的游戏内容。秉持着开放、包容、共享的理念，我们持续添加新的游戏玩法， 以及激动人心的活动，为玩家提供新鲜刺激的游戏体验。

> Server's en_us translation is still in progress, we welcome your help.

---

## 🎨 Features

### 🏗 Creative Mode
The server runs in **Creative Mode**, allowing players to build freely without resource limitations.

Focus on:
- Architecture
- City planning
- Landscape design
- Creative projects

---

### 🧱 WorldEdit Support
The server provides **WorldEdit** tools to help builders work more efficiently.

Features include:
- Region copy & paste
- Mass block editing
- Fast structure building
- Large-scale building support

---

### 🏡 Plot System
Each player can obtain their own **building plot**.

Features:
- Private building area
- Protection from griefing
- Plot expansion available
- Perfect for city projects

---

### 🌆 City Building Community
ATCraftMC encourages players to collaborate on **large city projects**.

You can:
- Build your own city
- Join community city projects
- Collaborate on large builds

---

### 🗺 Online Map
The server provides a **live online map** of the world.

Map can be found on our Official Website(only ZH_CN version.)

You can:
- View player builds
- Explore cities
- Plan new building areas

---

### 🎤 Voice Communication
Our community supports **voice communication**, making collaboration and discussion easier.

---

## 👥 Community

ATCraftMC aims to create a **friendly and creative building community**.

We welcome:
- Builders
- City planners
- Creative designers
- Minecraft building teams

---

## 🌍 Join Us

- Website  `https://atcraftmc.cn`
- Minecraft: `game.atcraftmc.cn`
- QQ Group [733345889](https://qm.qq.com/q/RX0CbwwiYk)

Join **ATCraftMC** and start building your dream world!
